title: Soph Upgrade Addons
description: Unofficial addon for Sophisticated Backpacks. Adds several useful upgrades.
body:
# Mod Features & Upgrades
## 🛠️ Base Upgrades *Upgrades that enhance the core functionality of your backpacks.* ### 🌌 Ender Upgrade The backpack can still be opened via hotkey even when placed inside an Ender Chest, and all upgrades within the backpack remain active. ### 🕳️ Super Void Upgrade Features significantly more filter slots than the standard *Advanced Void Upgrade*. --- ## 🔗 Mod Integrations *Special upgrades that bridge your backpack with other amazing mods. (Required dependent mods are listed in brackets).* ### 💾 Refined Storage Integration > **Requires:** `Refined Storage` * **RS Network Magnet Upgrade** Attracts dropped items and deposits them directly into your RS network. Includes a GUI toggle to allow or prevent item destruction by Void Upgrades. * **RS Network Pickup Upgrade** Picks up dropped items and deposits them directly into the RS network instantly. * **RS Discharge Upgrade** Functions identically to the standard *Discharge Upgrade*, but supports the RS network, allowing items to be discharged into any storage block within the network. ### 💧 Thirst Was Taken Integration > **Requires:** `Thirst Was Taken` * **Drink Upgrade** Automatically drinks beverages for the player when thirst level drops. * **Advanced Drink Upgrade** Features all benefits of the base Drink Upgrade, but allows filtering drinks by water purity levels. ### ⚡ Apotheosis Integration > **Requires:** `Apotheosis` * **Potion Charm Upgrade** Allows Apotheosis potion charms placed inside this upgrade to take effect as if they were in the player's inventory. Features **4 slots** of capacity by default. * **Advanced Potion Charm Upgrade** Functions identically to the base Potion Charm Upgrade, but features an expanded **9 slots** of capacity.
